record.question: The sun __________ set, we decided to go home.
record.explanation: The sun having set is a perfect-participial absolute phrase giving the earlier circumstance. Having been set would give an inappropriate passive sense to the sun's setting; has set would create a comma splice. Original printed question, exact option order and required context reviewed; independently worked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner key is asserted.
